text.p: Buckeye Cellulose Corp said Wednesday it has completed its tender offer for Merfin Inc, with well over 97 percent of Merfin's outstanding shares tendered.
Buckeye said it intends to pay today for all the common shares tendered at C$7.50 per share.

Merfin executive vice president James Westphal said, "We are delighted to have this transaction come to such a positive conclusion. We at Merfin see many synergies with Buckeye, and we look forward to a bright future."
On May 14, Buckeye Cellulose, a maker of high quality cellulose, sweetened its bid for Merfin, which produces air-laid nonwoven fabrics, to C$7.50 a share from $7.20.
Rival bidder Polymer Group Inc then withdrew its C$7.20 a share offer.
Merfin advised shareholders on the same day to accept the sweetened Buckeye offer.
